analyst_view.overall: Real Sociedad (5th, 19 pts) played Lyon in the Europa League on Thursday, which one report gives as 1-1, after losing the derby 2-1 at Athletic. A lineup preview expects rotation. Rayo (12th, 12 pts) have no midweek game and come in rested after a 3-0 home win over Celta, but they have not won away this season: 2 draws and 3 defeats, 6 scored and 13 conceded.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals. Rayo have shipped 13 goals in five away games and are without Álvaro García, Óscar Valentín and keeper Augusto Batalla. One preview also lists right-back Andrei Rațiu as doubtful, and the site does not have him. Real Sociedad have been scoring freely, with 5 at Málaga and 6 at Lillestrøm in October, and the last two meetings at Vallecas finished 3-3 and 2-2.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.5 corners. Real Sociedad should have most of the ball at home, but rotation after Thursday's European game could take some edge off their wide play. Nothing in the news moves this either way.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.4 cards. No referee had been named in what we found, and neither side has a specific disciplinary story this week. We stay with the model.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.3 shots. Rayo's leaky away defence points up, while Real Sociedad's likely rotation three days after Lyon points down. On balance we see no clear reason to move from the model.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.1 shots on target. Real Sociedad's attack (Oyarzabal, Kubo, Oskarsson) is in scoring form, but rotation could change who starts. One report lists centre-back Mamadou Sarr as doubtful with a muscle problem.
